### Workflow handoff: urlshort-slice@1 step design_review

This step: design_review (design_review)
Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Design ready on SPEC b8c327b. Impact analysis 3ebfb09 predates the design aa36c8b; the commit after it gives AC-3 its own peer, folds a missing day row to zeros, and adds builder notes. The hash is compared only within clicked_on, the salt's day (Q2 B). A join was rejected on the S2 plan; cost 146-202 ms cold for a 225k-click link (S3, S5). Identity: RateLimitFilter becomes public with CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE set to its clientOf result before charging, and ClickRecorder hashes it, falling back to getRemoteAddr. Grant c78500e is used within its conditions: decisions unchanged, existing RateLimitFilterTest cases unchanged, no other web/ file, clientOf kept package-private. Not the wrapper, because getRemoteAddr stays the connection address for every reader, ADR-0019's audit check included. Counters urlshort.clicks.recorded and urlshort.clicks.lost{reason}, every reason pre-registered (S4). Shipped tests changed by intent: StatsJourneyTest AC09 lines 113-114, ClickRecordingJourneyTest line 223, unit LinkStatsTest, unit ClickRecorderTest. No migration, no Flyway number; builds after both mission-02 w1 merges. ADR-0013, ADR-0015 and ADR-0016 amendments.
